class.name: legged_hw/LeggedHW
class.description: ros2_control hardware interface for legged robot. Receives RobotStatePacket (joint pos/vel/torque + IMU) via UDP. Sends JointCommandPacket (pos/vel/torque_ff + kp/kd) via UDP. Exposes standard ros2_control state and command interfaces so joint_state_broadcaster and imu_sensor_broadcaster work out of the box.
